## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. For a change to delivery or verification, name the stage affected and the evidence used to check it. Link related issues.

## Validation

- [ ] Lint, format check, typecheck, tests and production build pass.
- [ ] Meaningful behavior changes have appropriate tests.
- [ ] UI changes pass the production browser journey and were checked with keyboard and dashboard themes, where applicable.
- [ ] Installation changes were exercised on the target platform.
- [ ] No secrets, generated bundles or local settings are included.

See the [contributor guide](https://github.com/lucasmkrx/bugsnitch/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the commands that exercise each component. Contributed MPL-covered source is provided under MPL-2.0. Bugsnitch [brand assets](https://github.com/lucasmkrx/bugsnitch/blob/main/assets/brand/README.md) have separate terms.
